items.t: Inner tie rod or steering rack failure
items.job: Replace power steering rack (or inner tie rods if only they are worn)
items.note: Replacing only worn inner tie rods costs far less than a whole rack. Add an alignment afterward.

items.t: Power steering leaks or heavy steering
items.note: If the pump or a hose is the leak instead, the repair is much cheaper.

items.t: Fuel rail or O-ring fuel leak (recall)
items.job: Reinforce or replace fuel rail and replace O-rings (recall 98V184000)
items.note: Free at a Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Car can roll away after the key is removed (recall)
items.job: Install new shifter interlock push rod (recall 04V021000)
items.note: Free at a Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Front seat back can suddenly recline (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Shoulder belt height adjuster bolt may not hold (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Front seat belt retractor may not lock (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Missing B-pillar head-impact padding (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Water pump failure damages the timing belt
items.job: Replace water pump with timing belt and tensioner
items.note: If the belt already broke and bent valves, cylinder head work adds well over $1,000.

items.t: Overheating
items.note: The cause may instead be a cooling fan or water pump, which changes the price.

items.t: Oil pump failure and engine damage
items.note: If the engine was already damaged by low oil pressure, a used or rebuilt engine is usually needed instead.

items.t: Stalling while driving or at idle
items.job: Diagnose stalling and read stored codes
items.note: Diagnosis only. The repair depends on what is found.

items.t: Clockspring failure: airbag light, horn and cruise stop working
Battery drain and interior lights cycling on their own
items.note: Diagnosis only. The faulty module or wiring adds to the cost.

items.t: Worn subframe and control arm bushings
items.job: Replace front control arm with bushings
items.note: RepairPal shows 1999-2001 cars costing much more than 1996-1997. Add an alignment.

items.t: Lower ball joint wear
Warped front brake rotors
Power window stops working
items.note: Later 1999-2001 cars cost more than 1996-1997 cars.

items.t: Power door locks fail or doors won't open from inside
Heated seat overheats and burns
items.note: A replacement heating element and upholstery repair add parts cost.

items.t: Instrument cluster or dash lights cut out
items.job: Diagnose and repair cluster ground or wiring
